name_zh: 真纳/巴基斯坦建国/穆斯林国家/独立运动/印巴分治
description_zh: 穆罕默德·阿里·真纳 (1876-1948) 印度穆斯林领袖，创建巴基斯坦国，领导穆斯林独立运动，实现印巴分治，建立第一个现代伊斯兰国家，确立两民族理论，奠定巴基斯坦地缘政治基础，被誉为'国父'。
description_en: Muhammad Ali Jinnah (1876-1948) Indian Muslim leader, founded Pakistan state, led Muslim independence movement, achieved India-Pakistan partition, established first modern Islamic state, established two-nation theory, laid foundation for Pakistan geopolitical structure, known as 'Father of the Nation'.
reason_zh: 真纳代表穆斯林民族建国如何重塑南亚地缘政治格局，展示了宗教民族主义如何推动独立运动，其两民族理论影响了印巴分治进程，其建国模式影响了后殖民国家建设，其国父地位塑造了巴基斯坦国家认同。
reason_en: Jinnah represents how Muslim nation-building reshapes South Asian geopolitical landscape, demonstrates how religious nationalism drives independence movements, his two-nation theory influenced India-Pakistan partition process, his state-building model influences post-colonial nation construction, his founding father status shapes Pakistani national identity.
steps_zh: 研究真纳早年印度/法律职业/政治崛起
分析1906-1940年穆斯林联盟/两民族理论形成
探讨1940-1947年独立运动/直接行动日/暴力冲突
评估1947年建国/难民危机/印巴分治
总结建国遗产/领土争端/克什米尔问题/国家认同
steps_en: Study Jinnah early India/legal career/political rise
Explore 1940-1947 independence movement/Direct Action Day/violent conflicts
Summarize founding legacy/territorial disputes/Kashmir issue/national identity
expected_zh: 理解穆斯林民族建国如何重塑南亚地缘政治格局，掌握宗教民族主义如何推动独立运动，评估两民族理论对印巴分治的影响，认识建国模式在后殖民国家建设中的作用。
expected_en: Understand how Muslim nation-building reshapes South Asian geopolitical landscape, grasp how religious nationalism drives independence movements, evaluate two-nation theory impact on India-Pakistan partition, recognize state-building model role in post-colonial nation construction.
case_zh: 1940年拉合尔决议；1947年蒙巴顿方案；1947年8月14日建国。民族独立/两民族理论/印巴分治/国家认同建构。
case_en: 1940 Lahore Resolution; 1947 Mountbatten Plan; August 14, 1947 State Establishment. National independence/Two-nation theory/India-Pakistan partition/National identity construction.
cross_cultural_impact: South Asian independence/Islamic nationalism/India-Pakistan partition/Bangladesh liberation/Regional geopolitics
artistic_legacy: 是: 国家神话/政治形象
conflict_resolution_mechanism: 政治谈判/国际仲裁/军事威慑
